description: Triage an inbox message (write scope): read=true/false (mark read/unread), spam=true/false (move to/from spam), client_id=<id> to link it to a client or null to unlink, box='shared'|'me'|<user_id> to move it to the shared inbox, your own, or a teammate's personal inbox. Pass any combination.

client_id.description: A client's id (from search or list_clients).

id.description: The record's numeric id, from the matching list/get/search tool.

name: triage_inbox_message
title: Triage Inbox Message
